title: GRAVITAS GCS Master Architecture — All Subsystems
description: Level 1 view showing all 12 major subsystem groups and their primary inter-subsystem dependencies. Each subsystem is further detailed in dedicated architecture files.

groups.label: A. Core Architecture
groups.description: Vehicle registry, protocol adapters, telemetry, events, API gateway, schema management

metadata.notes: Foundation layer. All other subsystems depend on core services.

groups.label: B. Communications
groups.description: Transport, networking, link monitoring, encryption, offline operation

metadata.notes: Provides all communication services to core and operational layers.

groups.label: F. Vehicle Operations
groups.description: Command & control, missions, fleet management, manual control, preflight, recovery

metadata.notes: Operational logic. Depends on core, communications, planning, and security.

groups.label: E. Planning & Navigation
groups.description: Centralized, decentralized, hybrid planning; motion models; deconfliction; fleet optimization

metadata.notes: Route planning and navigation. Uses motion models, terrain, energy data.

groups.label: D. COP & Geospatial
groups.description: Common operational picture, maps, terrain, geofences, overlays, replay

groups.label: G. Sensors & FOV
groups.description: Sensor integration, FOV, coverage analysis, fusion, observations

metadata.notes: Sensor intelligence layer. Feeds COP and planning.

groups.label: H. Payload, Video & Media
groups.description: Payload management, camera, gimbal, video streaming, recording, media storage

metadata.notes: Payload and media layer. Depends on sensor integration and comms.

groups.label: I. Security & Reliability
groups.description: Auth, RBAC, safety, fault detection, recovery, audit

metadata.notes: Cross-cutting security and reliability. All operational subsystems depend on this.

groups.label: J. Data & Observability
groups.description: Persistence, telemetry history, logging, health dashboard, alerts, backup

groups.label: K. Customization & Intelligence
groups.description: Plugins, automation, rules, AI diagnostics, dashboards, workflows

metadata.notes: Customization and intelligence layer. Uses plugin framework from core.

groups.label: C. Cross-Platform
groups.description: Runtime, OS compatibility, deployment, performance, updates

metadata.notes: Platform abstraction layer. Enables cross-OS support.

groups.label: L. Testing & Simulation
groups.description: SITL, HIL, automated testing, fault injection, performance, release validation

metadata.notes: Testing and validation layer. Tests all other subsystems.

semantic.label: Transport Data → Core
semantic.dataType: Raw vehicle data received through communication transports
semantic.description: Communications layer delivers raw transport data to the core for protocol-specific decoding and normalization

semantic.label: Normalized State → COP
semantic.dataType: Normalized vehicle state, position, status, events
semantic.description: Core provides normalized vehicle state to COP for visualization

semantic.label: Link Status → COP
semantic.dataType: Communication link status, network topology
semantic.description: Communications provides link status for COP network overlay display

semantic.label: Vehicle Services → Operations
semantic.dataType: Vehicle registry, capabilities, command interfaces, adapter services
semantic.description: Core provides vehicle services and adapter interfaces to the operations layer

semantic.label: Vehicle Capabilities → Planning
semantic.dataType: Vehicle capability profiles, motion constraints, operational limits
semantic.description: Core provides vehicle capability data so planners can validate route feasibility

semantic.label: Planning Requests ↔ Routes
semantic.dataType: Planning requests (objectives, constraints) and planned routes
semantic.description: Operations submits planning requests; planning returns proposed routes for validation and approval

semantic.label: Terrain & Geofences → Planning
semantic.dataType: Terrain data, elevation, geofences, restricted areas, environmental constraints
semantic.description: COP provides geospatial constraints to the planning subsystem for route generation and validation

semantic.label: Mission Data → COP
semantic.dataType: Active missions, waypoints, routes, execution progress
semantic.description: Operations provides mission visualization data to COP for display

semantic.label: Sensor Registry → Sensors
semantic.dataType: Registered sensors, capabilities, association with vehicles
semantic.description: Core provides sensor registry data to the sensor subsystem

semantic.label: FOV Overlays → COP
semantic.dataType: FOV geometries, coverage overlays, observation markers
semantic.description: Sensor subsystem provides FOV overlays and observation data to COP for visualization on the operational map

semantic.label: Coverage Data → Planning
semantic.dataType: Sensor coverage analysis, visibility constraints, observation quality
semantic.description: Sensor subsystem provides coverage data to planning for coverage-oriented route optimization

semantic.label: Auth & Validation → Core
semantic.dataType: Authentication decisions, authorization tokens, validation results
semantic.description: Security provides authentication and authorization services to core for all vehicle and adapter operations

semantic.label: Safety Policies → Operations
semantic.dataType: Safety interlock states, command authorization, operational risk assessments
semantic.description: Security enforces safety policies and authorization gates on all operational commands and mission actions

semantic.label: Encryption Config → Comms
semantic.dataType: Encryption keys, certificate configuration, secure transport policies
semantic.description: Security provides encryption configuration and certificate management to the communications layer

semantic.label: Audit Records → Data
semantic.dataType: Audit trail entries, authorization decisions, incident records
semantic.description: Security persists audit records and incident evidence through the data layer

semantic.label: Events & Telemetry → Data
semantic.dataType: Normalized telemetry records, system events, vehicle state changes
semantic.description: Core streams processed telemetry and events to the data layer for persistence and time-series storage

semantic.label: Mission & Command Records → Data
semantic.dataType: Mission records, command history, execution outcomes, preflight results
semantic.trigger: Mission lifecycle events and command completion
semantic.description: Operations persists mission and command records through the data layer for audit and replay

semantic.label: Link Metrics → Data
semantic.dataType: Link quality metrics, latency, packet loss, bandwidth, connection events
semantic.trigger: Periodic measurement and link state changes
semantic.description: Communications provides link performance metrics to the data layer for monitoring and diagnostics

semantic.label: Planning Records → Data
semantic.dataType: Planned routes, trajectory comparisons, planning evaluation results
semantic.description: Planning persists route records and evaluation data for historical analysis and replay

semantic.label: Plugin API → Customization
semantic.dataType: Extension interfaces, plugin registration hooks, SDK contracts
semantic.description: Core exposes the plugin API and extension SDK to the customization layer

semantic.label: Automated Actions → Operations
semantic.dataType: Automated command requests triggered by rules and workflows
semantic.description: Customization submits automated actions through the standard command pathway. Must pass authorization and safety validation.
assumptions: Automated actions enter the same command validation pipeline as operator commands

semantic.label: Operational Data → AI & Analytics
semantic.dataType: Historical telemetry, event logs, health metrics, incident records
semantic.trigger: AI diagnostic request and anomaly detection cycle
semantic.description: Data layer provides operational history to customization layer for AI-assisted diagnostics and anomaly detection

semantic.label: Sensor Config → Payload
semantic.dataType: Sensor calibration, pose data, FOV parameters for payload-mounted sensors
semantic.trigger: Sensor configuration change and payload initialization
semantic.description: Sensor subsystem provides calibration and configuration data to payload management for camera and gimbal coordination

semantic.label: Media Records → Data
semantic.dataType: Media metadata, recording references, stream lifecycle events
semantic.description: Payload persists media metadata and lifecycle records through the data layer

semantic.label: Platform Services → All Subsystems
semantic.dataType: OS abstraction, runtime services, device interfaces, environment configuration
semantic.description: Cross-platform layer provides OS-independent runtime services to all subsystems above. Representative connection shown to core; applies to all.
assumptions: Single representative edge shown. Platform services are consumed by all subsystems.

semantic.label: Test Interfaces ↔ All Subsystems
semantic.dataType: Test harness connections, simulation interfaces, fault injection points
semantic.description: Testing layer connects to all subsystems for simulation, automated testing, and fault injection. Representative connection shown to core.
assumptions: Single representative edge shown. Test interfaces connect to all subsystems.

requirementsCoverage.description: Capability-driven behavior: adapt to verified vehicle and controller capabilities
requirementsCoverage.notes: Core registry and adapter layers provide capability data to all consumers

requirementsCoverage.description: Universal extensibility: new integrations must not require rewriting the entire GCS
requirementsCoverage.notes: Plugin framework and adapter abstraction enable extensibility

requirementsCoverage.description: Protocol isolation: protocol-specific details outside shared domain logic and UI
requirementsCoverage.notes: Protocol adapters in core isolate protocol logic; transport in comms is protocol-agnostic

requirementsCoverage.description: Clear service boundaries: telemetry, commands, planning, persistence, diagnostics must have explicit interfaces
requirementsCoverage.notes: Each subsystem has defined ports and interfaces in this diagram

requirementsCoverage.description: Safe command execution: every command through authorization, validation and safety controls
requirementsCoverage.notes: Security enforces auth and safety gates on all command paths including automation

requirementsCoverage.description: Fault containment: failure of one integration must not unnecessarily disable unrelated functionality
requirementsCoverage.notes: Detailed fault isolation boundaries shown in sec-03 and core subsystem files

requirementsCoverage.description: Network resilience: every critical communication path must define failure and recovery behavior
requirementsCoverage.notes: Detailed failover and recovery in comm-05 and flow-09

requirementsCoverage.description: Offline resilience: locally available functionality and sync behavior explicitly defined
requirementsCoverage.notes: Detailed offline architecture in comm-05 and flow-09

requirementsCoverage.description: Cross-platform separation: domain logic independent of OS-specific interfaces
requirementsCoverage.notes: Platform layer provides OS abstraction to all subsystems

requirementsCoverage.description: Secure customization: extensions under defined permissions, resource limits, lifecycle rules
requirementsCoverage.notes: Plugin lifecycle in cust-01; permissions enforced through sec

requirementsCoverage.description: Data integrity: operational records preserve provenance, timestamps, validation status
requirementsCoverage.notes: Data provenance engine detailed in data-02

requirementsCoverage.description: Auditable operation: consequential commands, config changes, admin actions traceable
requirementsCoverage.notes: Audit engine in sec-04; persistence in data-03

requirementsCoverage.description: Continuous testing: regression, integration, fault-injection, compatibility testing in release process
requirementsCoverage.notes: Testing subsystem detailed in test-01 through test-03

requirementsCoverage.description: No false execution claims: command submission, acknowledgement, verified execution remain distinct
requirementsCoverage.notes: Command tracking engine in ops-05; uncertainty handling in sec-03

assumptions.description: All engines are logical components. Deployment as separate processes is not assumed unless requirements specify it.
assumptions.justification: Requirements state clear service boundaries but do not mandate microservice deployment.

assumptions.description: At the master architecture level, each subsystem is represented as a single node. Internal engine-level detail is deferred to subsystem-specific files.
assumptions.justification: The master diagram provides a Level 1 overview. 152 engines cannot be meaningfully displayed in a single view.
